description: This file defines the structure and class for managing the context of a generic media player within a GStreamer-based media server. It includes definitions for video geometry, internal state flags, and references to GStreamer elements and media streams, facilitating media playback control and state management.

classes.name: Rectangle
classes.description: Structure used for representing video geometry with position and size.

classes.name: GenericPlayerContext
classes.description: Structure encapsulating the state and resources for a media player instance, including GStreamer elements, stream info, flags for data requests, buffers, and playback state.
